warnings: Axes: x = numbered grids 1, 2 (3.60 apart); y = Thai-lettered rows printed top-to-bottom ค, ข, ก (3.00 + 3.00). Origin = the top-left main grid ค1, so ค is y=0 and ก is y=6.00 (row letters keep the drawing's own Thai alphabet, §0.8).

Rule 4 (every printed x/y tick is a line) applied across the set, architectural sheets included — that is why x carries 9 dummies anchored to grid 1 (1' … 1'''''''''). Only 4 carry a structural element (1' S0 edge / roof eave, 1''''' ridge, 1'''''' B4, 1''''''' B3*); the rest are stair, landing and wall ticks from A-04/A-08, kept so a later read can land on them.

x 2.30 (1'''''') and 2.40 (1''''''') are genuinely different lines, 0.10 apart: the ground-floor beam B4 sits at 2.30 (S-01, A-04 ground plan) while the upper-floor stair-head beam B3* sits at 2.40 (S-02, A-04 upper plan). A-08 adds a third tick at 2.50 (top of the stair run). None merged.

Stair landing position disagrees between disciplines: structural S-01 draws slab S0 from 1.00 left of grid 1 up to grid 1 (x -1.00 … 0), while A-04/A-08 draw the landing/แท่น คสล. centred on grid 1 (x -0.50 … +0.50). Structural wins for the S0 element (op01 precedence rule 1); the architectural ticks are still recorded as lines 1'' and 1''''.

Ridge line 1''''' (x=1.80) is printed only on A-05 (2.80|2.80 from the eave lines); S-02's roof-framing plan draws it as the symmetry axis with no dimension. 2.80 + 2.80 = 5.60 = 1.00 + 3.60 + 1.00, so the chain closes.

Roof edges: two printed edge distances at each gable end — 1.00 (inner chain: tip of the cantilevered ring beam RB1x, and the roof edge on A-05) and 1.20 (outer chain: outermost edge on S-02 and the 1.20 on A-06/A-07). Kept as separate lines ค''/ค' and ก'/ก''.

z chain mismatch, recorded not resolved: A-07 prints the ridge as +7.375 (รูปตัด ก) and +7.345 (รูปตัด ข), but both sections' z chains give ระดับหลังอะเส 5.20 + 1.875 = 7.075. Neither label matches the chain; both labels and the chain kept verbatim.

Level label conflict, recorded not resolved: A-04 labels the open ground under the house 'ใต้ถุน +0.00' while A-07 labels 'ระดับใต้ถุน +0.20'; the enclosed ground-floor rooms (ห้องครัว, ห้องน้ำ, ระดับห้อง) are +0.20 everywhere. Both kept.

Not promoted to lines (decisions): (a) toilet fixture setting-out dimensions on A-09 — fixture positions inside one room detail, treated like rule 4's 'dimension inside one element's own detail'; (b) the A-03 site plan's lot/setback dimensions ('A', 2.10 to the boundary) — the sheet self-declares it is an example for estimating ('ผังบริเวณนี้เป็นเพียงตัวอย่าง'), so it never overrides building geometry; (c) S-05 beam/slab elevations (B6's 1.80|1.20 step, B2's 1.20 bar extension, 0.375 cut-offs, slab spans) — element detail drawn between unlabeled bubbles, recorded on the elements instead.

Sheets not dimension-swept (outside op04 scope, nothing structural): the cover (page 1), A-01 สารบัญแบบ/สัญลักษณ์ (page 2), A-02 รายการประกอบแบบ (page 3), E-01 electrical (page 17) and SN-01 sanitary (page 18).
